implementation.targetScope: Notistack 3.0.2's css(object) contract: declarations, nested selectors and conditional rules, content-derived classes, deduplication, DOM/SSR targets, extraction and VPM stylesheet hydration. No styled components, tagged/raw CSS templates, prefixer setup, keyframes/global helpers or Babel integration.

changes: Independent serializer and per-target ownership; no Goober runtime copied or delegated to upstream.
Only own style properties are read; invalid finite values, cycles, excessive nesting and unsafe keys reject before insertion.
Styles use their target's document and nonce; removed stylesheets are reconstructed on the next call.
Compiled content cache is bounded to 128 entries; input objects are not cached by identity and mutations remain visible.
Generated class names differ from upstream; VPM server/client styles must be migrated together. Extraction clears target bookkeeping so repeat calls reinsert rules.
Null/false values are omitted, ms vendor properties are normalized, and property fallback arrays reject rather than becoming nested numeric selectors.

caller.scope: useSnackbar calls flow through unchanged Notistack 3.0.2. Its 20 style definitions use css(object) only. Current/app controls and real React 19.3.1 browser notifications are verified; no app adoption or release claimed.
